methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 8 same-sector + similar-valuation-tier peers in AI & Software. Range: $1.0B - $10.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Field AI, an AI & Software company at IPO stage, commands a current valuation of $2.0B against $405M in total capital raised. The valuation assessment draws from a peer set of 8 private companies in the same sector and valuation tier, supplemented by reference to public comparables including Palantir (PLTR), though the analysis relies primarily on private peer triangulation given Field AI's stage and business profile.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach, drawing from 8 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier private companies. This cohort—including Crusoe Energy ($10.0B), Wayve ($8.6B), Together AI ($8.3B), SandboxAQ ($5.8B), and Physical Intelligence ($5.6B)—yields a median valuation of $5.7B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $10.0B. This single-method triangulation implies a valuation of $5.7B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $4.8B to $6.5B, centered on the peer median of $5.7B. This suggests Field AI's current $2.0B valuation sits materially below recent comparables in stage and sector, implying substantial upside to IPO pricing relative to peer multiples. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 8-peer set given heterogeneity in AI subsectors and capital efficiency, the timing lag in peer valuations, and Field AI's specific revenue trajectory and unit economics relative to the comp universe. Additional methods incorporating revenue or earnings multiples would strengthen conviction, should such data become available.
